author: Akien
prose:
before you do, let's think just a hair more on this: the inference domain is supposed to create a inference ticket. that should be something you can get back from it. and it should list every byte up and down. so we can inspect that as well.

[and, in the same breath, folding in the thread this redirected — Akien, moments earlier:] "i think that's a good idea. can we tweak it's prompts at all? if so, then we ask it to tell us what's wrong." ... "oh duh, i'm being stupid. we just add that to the top of the ticket."

[and closing:] "so if that changes anything get that in there too. you've just compacted. and then i think we're ready to cast"
